title: WASD Character
cue: third-person character: run, jump, stairs, clips, camera
summary: A third-person character in one node: camera-relative movement, a forgiving jump, stairs taken in stride, feet placed on steps and slopes, animations paced so feet do not slide, and an orbit camera.
useWhen: The player, an enemy, or a companion is a character on foot in a 3D game: a third-person adventure or action game, a platformer whose hero is a humanoid, or click to move. With universal-animation-library a human walks, runs, and jumps with no animation code; phantom-camera can take over its camera.
avoidWhen: A first-person game: a shooter starts from starter-kit-fps, one without weapons from a hand-built CharacterBody3D or that kit's player without its weapon code. Also a vehicle, a 2D game, a grid mover, a crowd (wasd-crowd), or a platformer on a ready level with coins (starter-kit-3d-platformer).
